acs.text_first_line: AC1 The treatment panel answers the generation gate
AC2 A treatment that is not approved, or is closed, cannot generate
AC3 The set summary is read from the document service in one hop
AC4 Send availability follows the set the owner reports
AC5 The document service being unavailable does not break the treatment read
AC6 The set must be the set the treatment type requires
AC7 The panel reaches SCR-14 through the composite route
AC8 The panel carries no personal value and publishes no event
